User Story: As a registered user I want to log in securely so that I can access permitted functions
As an administrator I want role-based permissions so that users access only authorized functions
As a user I want to log out so that my session is not left open
As an administrator I want to register a student so that an academic record can be maintained
As authorized staff I want to search students so that records can be found quickly
As an administrator I want to update student details so that records remain current
As an authorized administrator I want to deactivate an obsolete record so that it is not used incorrectly
As an administrator I want to create a course so that it can be assigned to students
As an administrator I want to update course details so that the catalogue remains accurate
As authorized staff I want to assign students to courses so that enrolments are recorded
As faculty I want to record attendance by course and date so that records remain accurate
As faculty I want to view saved attendance so that I can verify records
As faculty I want to enter marks so that performance is recorded
As faculty I want grades calculated by approved rules so that grading is consistent
As academic staff I want a result sheet so that results can be reviewed
As authorized staff I want attendance reports so that attendance can be reviewed
As a user I want to reset my password through a verified process so that I can regain access
As a student I want an attendance alert at a defined threshold so that I can take corrective action
As a student I want examination notifications so that I can prepare on time
As a student I want a result notification so that I know when results are available
As academic staff I want student reports so that I can review student details
As faculty I want performance reports so that I can review marks and grades
As an administrator I want course reports so that I can review enrolment information
As an administrator I want an academic analytics dashboard so that I can identify broad trends
